g.text: From open evening to first practice
Newcomers at our open evenings find a clear, no-pressure next step into a first practice session, so interest
Nobody feels recruited or pressured · Organisers' hours stay as they are
Newcomers at a first practice within 3 weeks…
What one small change could you try at the next open evening, and what do you expect it to
RECORDED IN THE TREES FROM YOUR ANSWER
We never offer a next step at the end of an open evening
“People come to one open evening and we never see them again.
Nobody tells them what to do next: we never offer a next step.”
